Single_Point_Energy.description: Calculate a molecule's electronic energy and electronic properties at a fixed geometry without optimizing or moving its atoms. The platform uses GPU-accelerated GPU4PySCF for rapid single-point DFT calculations. Use this tool for energy ranking, conformer comparison, electronic-property profiling, reaction-intermediate screening, charge/dipole analysis, method benchmarking, or validation of an already optimized structure.

method.description: DFT functional. Proven value: `"B3LYP"`. UI options: `B3LYP`, `PBE`, `PBE0`, `M06-2X`, `wB97X-D`, `wB97M-V`, `HF`, `LDA`, `TPSS`, and `CAM-B3LYP`.

charge.description: Total formal charge of the whole modeled species. Proven value: `0`. Use `0` for neutral species and explicit positive/negative integers for ions.

spin_multiplicity.description: **The verified API payload uses a string.** Proven value: `"1"`. Use `"1"` for singlet, `"2"` for doublet, or `"3"` for triplet; set radicals and metal systems explicitly.
